name: SearchField
description: A search field has a search icon, a clear button and an optional keyboard shortcut that focuses it from anywhere on the page. Enter searches and Escape clears. It is built on InputField.
whenToUse: To search or filter content on a page or across the site.
In toolbars and headers, often with a shortcut such as / or ⌘K.

whenNotToUse.text: To pick a value from a known list.

states.name: Filled
states.meaning: Clear button instead of the hint.

behavior.text: Enter calls onSearch; Escape clears; the shortcut focuses the field (a single-key shortcut like / is ignored while typing in another field).
The label is visually hidden by default (“Search”) but always announced; set showLabel to show it.
“mod+k” means ⌘K on Mac and Ctrl+K elsewhere; exposed as aria-keyshortcuts.

content: Placeholder: what can be searched, e.g. “Search products”.
Wrap page-level search in a <search> element or role="search" landmark.

guidelines.do: Say what is searched in the placeholder or label.
guidelines.why: People need to know the scope of the search.

guidelines.do: Use a familiar shortcut like / or ⌘K.
guidelines.dont: Bind letters people type everywhere, like s.
guidelines.why: Single-letter shortcuts clash with typing and assistive tech.

guidelines.do: Show results as people type only when it’s fast.
guidelines.dont: Run a slow search on every keystroke.
guidelines.why: Laggy results are worse than pressing Enter.

accessibility.focus: Clearing returns focus to the field.

wcag.how: Single-key shortcuts only fire when not typing elsewhere.

examples.title: Search
examples.code:
import { SearchField } from '@ds/react';

<SearchField placeholder="Search products" onSearch={(q) => navigate(`/search?q=${q}`)} />

examples.title: With a shortcut
examples.code:
import { SearchField } from '@ds/react';

<search>
  <SearchField placeholder="Search docs" shortcut="mod+k" />
</search>

examples.title: Live filter
examples.code:
import { SearchField } from '@ds/react';

<SearchField label="Filter orders" placeholder="Filter orders" value={q} onValueChange={setQ} size="small" />

related.relation: The field it is built on.

components.name: SearchField
components.description:
A field for searching: search icon, clear button and an optional keyboard shortcut.
Built on InputField.

label.description: Names the field. Default "Search"; hidden unless showLabel is set.

showLabel.description: Shows the label above the field. By default the search icon and placeholder carry it.

shortcut.description:
Key that focuses the field from anywhere on the page, e.g. "/" or "mod+k" (⌘K on Mac,
Ctrl+K elsewhere). Shown as a hint and exposed with aria-keyshortcuts.

onSearch.description: Called with the query when Enter is pressed.

onValueChange.description: Called with the new query as people type or clear.

size.description: `small` for dense UI, `medium` by default, `large` for prominent forms.

hideLabel.description:
Hides the label visually but keeps it for screen readers. Only for fields whose purpose
is obvious from context, such as a search box with a search icon.

optional.description: Marks the field optional with text after the label. Use when most fields are required.

optionalLabel.description: Text shown for optional fields. Default "(optional)".

description.description: Help text under the field, e.g. format hints.

error.description: Error message. Marks the field invalid and replaces the success message.

clearLabel.description: Accessible name of the clear button. Default "Clear".

--search-field-shortcut-bg-color.description: App background behind cards and panels.

--search-field-shortcut-text-color.description: Supporting text on surfaces: descriptions, metadata, placeholders.

--search-field-shortcut-border-radius.description: Small rounding for tiny elements: checkboxes, tags.

--search-field-shortcut-padding-x.description: Tightest gap between tightly related items, e.g. icon and label.

--search-field-shortcut-font-family.description: Body text and most UI text.
